messages:
sophie: quick follow-up from the 2026-03-10 postmortem (missing spans / aggregation drift). goal: produce a sprint-limited remediation checklist with clear owners + rollback-safe timelines. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg
omar: +1. I'd like us to prioritize low-risk changes first (alerts, dry-run backfill) before schema/migration work.
lee: i'll take alerts & observability work. plan: add span_coverage_ratio metric, a viz in console, and an alert that pages if ratio < 0.80 for 2 consecutive 6h sweeps. ETA 2 days.
devon: i'll own the controlled backfill orchestration. proposal: job `remed.spans.backfill.v1` with `--dry-run`, `--max-window=48h`, and `--concurrency=2`. run dry-run against a snapshot and validate diffs before any writes. ETA dry-run 1d, safe rollout 6d.
sophie: thanks. who can take the aggregator join hardening? this was the root cause in the postmortem (nulls + window misalignment).
lee: i can do a non-invasive guard first: add defensive logic in the rollup reader to treat nulls as explicit defaults at runtime (feature flagged), then follow with a migration. ETA for guard flag: 3d.
omar: i'll coordinate the DB migration to normalize key columns and populate safe defaults. we should schedule it in a low-traffic window and include an idempotent backout plan. ETA to schedule + prep: 4 days.
ops-bot: historical-pattern-detect: similar incidents detected 2025-10-12 and 2026-01-05. recurring-pattern flagged; recommend quarterly "rollup-health" audit.
sophie: add quarterly audit event and assign to platform + observability. Also create remediation ticket REM-4521 and attach all owners.
devon: for safety, backfill will implement rate-limiting and an exponential backoff if DB latency > 200ms. dry-run will emit a CSV report and a sample of affected traces for manual spot-check.
lee: alert SQL snippet for runbook:
```
-- per-service coverage sweep
SELECT service, (sum(case when sampled then 1 else 0 end)::float / nullif(count(*),0)) as coverage
FROM spans
WHERE ingested_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY service
HAVING (sum(case when sampled then 1 else 0 end)::float / nullif(count(*),0)) < 0.80;
```
sophie: owners & ETAs summary: lee=alerts & guard-flag (2d/3d), devon=backfill (1d dry-run / 6d phased), omar=db migration scheduling (4d), sophie=remediation ticket + audit invite (1d), plus ajit oncall for paging. confirm?
omar: confirm. i'll coordinate infra change windows.
devon: confirm. i'll post the dry-run CSV here when ready and link to REM-4521.
lee: confirm. i'll push the guard-flag PR behind a kill-switch and include a smoke that asserts rollup_count >= 85% expected for top-10 services after rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: service=rollup-guard v0.1.0 by lee at 2026-03-10T20:12Z (auto-rollback=enabled)
sophie: final: i'll update the postmortem with these owners, create REM-4521, and set weekly check-ins until all items are green. if anyone needs to shift dates, ping here. :thumbsup:
